_doc: Topic labels (added 2026-11-10 at Michiko's request). Each topic tags articles (by issue + headline, plus page when a headline repeats in an issue) and events (by issue + name). build_viewer.py puts a chip on every tagged entry; the chip opens a page listing everything under the topic. The Events tab search also finds a topic by its label. To add an entry, add its issue and headline/name here and rebuild. A key that matches nothing stops the build.

topics.label: Streetcar discrimination
topics.note: Exclusion of Black riders from Philadelphia's city passenger railways (streetcars), and the protests, petitions and court cases against it. Related entries on railroad cars and on other cities are included (the 1837 Broadway omnibus in New York, the West Jersey Railroad, the Pennsylvania Railroad's separate car, Havre de Grace).
